probe_claims: Caffeine enhances attention and alertness in the short term.
Caffeine consumption can improve memory recall shortly after ingestion.
The effects of caffeine on cognitive performance are dose-dependent.
Caffeine has a greater impact on cognitive performance in sleep-deprived individuals.
Caffeine intake can lead to improved reaction times in various tasks.
The cognitive benefits of caffeine vary based on individual tolerance levels.
Habitual caffeine users may experience diminished cognitive benefits compared to non-users.
Caffeine can temporarily increase mental focus and concentration.
The effects of caffeine on cognitive performance can differ by age group.
Caffeine withdrawal can negatively impact short-term cognitive performance.
